title: Storage
unavailable: Detailed deduplicated storage metrics are unavailable for this repository.
savings: Deduplication saves {bytes} ({pct}%) versus the logical footprint.
sharedExplanation: “Shared” bytes are blobs this repository has in common with other repositories; reclaiming them requires the last referencing repository to release them.
instanceCaveat: Deduplication is pooled across the whole instance. Physical, unique, and shared figures reflect blobs that may be shared with other repositories and are not attributable to this repository alone.
instanceNote: Deduplicated storage is pooled across the instance; the detailed breakdown is available to administrators.
reclaimable: {bytes} could be reclaimed by garbage-collecting {count} unreferenced blob(s). This is a dry-run estimate; nothing was deleted.
